title: L4-F2: use_item must refuse unrecognized operation arguments before any mutation
description: Repair L4-F2 (evidence and reproducers in eshyra-o9bd.16.4 notes). toolUseItem.ts ~53-57 declares args an open object described as validated; itemState.ts ~1735-1744 reads only transitionOutcome and defaults to success; ~1901-1915 reads only the current variable economy key. A misspelled {transitionOutome:'failure'} on Rope of Entanglement entangle-creature succeeds, spends the action and records the success branch; Bag of Tricks {costs:{uses:0},unknown:'garbage'} succeeds. DESIGN (Captain): validate the complete recognized operation-specific argument shape and the applicable economy keys BEFORE any action, economy, timer, credit or RNG work; refuse unknown names and arguments inapplicable to the selected operation, naming the accepted keys in the error; keep deliberately supported omission defaults. Permanent evidence: a generalized unknown-argument refusal invariant asserting state and budgets unchanged, with one state-machine (Rope of Entanglement) and one economy-backed (Bag of Tricks) real-pack case plus positive declared-input controls.
notes:
L4-F2 report (commit 2b044c678b2425fa1e597ce7125a8a4b7f8bd74e on branch eshyra-o9bd.16.10.2, not pushed).

ACCEPTED ARGS PER OPERATION KIND:
- No state transition and no variable cost (e.g. Bag of Tricks pull-fuzzy-object, fixed cost 1 uses): args absent or {} only; any key refused, error says 'accepted args: none (this operation takes no args)'.
- Operation is the via of a stateMachine transition (Rope entangle-creature): transitionOutcome ('success'|'failure', default success) and transitionTo (optional when unambiguous). Any other key refused, error lists 'transitionOutcome, transitionTo'.
- Operation with variable-amount cost(s): costs = { <variable economyId>: positive integer }, one entry required per variable economy; a costs key outside that set is refused. Costs combined with transition keys are both accepted when both apply.
- args must be a plain object at the tool boundary; a non-object (string, array, null) returns invalid_args instead of being dropped.

REFUSAL POINT: itemState.ts validateOperationArgs(), called in useItem immediately after the operation is resolved and before assertActivationEquipment, the activation turn-resource spend, economy/cost accounting, timer resolution, credit issuance and RNG use. Registry boundary: toolUseItem.ts inputSchema now declares properties (transitionTo, transitionOutcome, costs) with additionalProperties false, so toolRegistry.invoke refuses unknown names before run().

OMISSION DEFAULTS KEPT: transitionOutcome absent = success; transitionTo optional when one candidate; args absent = no-op.

TESTS: new packages/core/test/itemUseArgsRefusal.test.ts (14 tests). Table of refusals through the registry (Rope {transitionOutome}, Rope {transitionOutcome:'failure',unknownPredicate:true}, Bag {costs:{uses:0},unknown:'garbage'}, plus unknown-only and fixed-cost costs cases), and item-layer cases through useItemTool.run that bypass the schema and assert the accepted-key message. Each refusal asserts the full DB snapshot (all tables) is byte-identical before and after, and Rope machineState unchanged. Positive controls: Rope transitionOutcome failure -> loose/failure; success and omitted -> restraining/success; Bag with no args and with {} -> spends one use.

VERIFY: npm run verify:worktree exit 0 (format, check, typecheck, test: 388 files passed, 2 skipped; 7264 tests passed, 3 skipped).

NOT DONE: no push, no PR. Variable-cost positive path (Pipes call-rat-swarms) is covered by existing itemChargeDawnRecharge and itemGrantBindCredit tests, not re-added here.
